# timbre

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:observablePropertyTimbre`](gmeow-observablePropertyTimbre.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/observablePropertyTimbre>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory`](../../slices/sensory.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The timbre observable property — the perceived tonal quality of a sound (bright, dark, breathy, gritty, hollow,...) that can be observed by a human listener or measured by an audio feature extractor.
